So we see that the office of the patriarch became hereditary, that is, it remained in the same family and went from father to son or some other relative, The patniarch now was quite sure that the property and things belonging to the tribe were really his own. Even when he died they remained in his family. We see how the idea of anything belonging to ‘me’ or ‘you’ started. There was no such idea to begin with. People all worked together for the tribe and not for themselves. If they produced aq lot ot food or other things everybody in the tribe got his share. There were no rich or poor in the tribe. They were all sharers in the property of the tribe. But as soon as the patriarch started grabbing at the things belonging to the tribe and calling them his own we begin to get rich people and poor people. I shall have something more to say about this in my next letter. 17 THE PATRIARCH BECOMES THE KING THE old patriarch has taken up a lot of our time, has he not? We shall finish with him soon, or rather he will change his name. I started by promising to tell you how kings came and what they were. And in order to understand kings one has to go right back to the patriarchs. . You must have guessed that these patriarchs became later on kings or wet andagrmmt. The word patriarch comes from the Latin ‘Pater’ or father. He was the leader and father of his tribe or people. ‘Patria’ which means father, or one’s own country, comes from the same Latin word, You know that in French it is ‘Patrie’. In Sanskrit and Hindi we think of our country as the mother or motherland—atqufa the motherland, Which do you prefer ?
